maintainedConsumer.need: Maintain the native dependency tuple while preserving its enumerated request-boundary and strict-input behavior. This is an internal maintenance need, not an observed paid bump ticket.

trigger: A maintainer registers a permitted upstream dependency transition or an actual changed consumer/requirement source through the existing mission intake. No new watcher, queue or scheduler is installed.

acceptanceOwner.role: Existing maintainer acceptance, with separate runtime/operator, Security and release gates

acceptance: Complete source-bound preservation or substantiated rejection of the exact component contract, usable next action, full original evidence and cost provenance. Missing required evidence cannot be admitted. Full application adoption remains separate.

deduplication.key: Consumer source bodies + requested requirement cases + native import projection + before/after versions and exact wheel identities + declared interpreter environment. Selected-call inputs use exact source/call/declaration relationships.
deduplication.defaultRequestId: upgrade- followed by the first 48 characters of the mission key; existing Strategy idempotency returns the same exact retained plan/outcome or refuses a conflicting exact input.
deduplication.counting: A repeated evaluation under an explicitly different engineering request ID remains the same underlying job. Cross-home aggregation/adoption is unqualified; the stable key is retained for the existing history/ledger, not used to migrate authority.

freshWorkOwner: Writer PR #4932; one frozen comparison, no separate product confirmation

frozenComparison.scope: Six representative historical transitions in two package clusters. Not actual historical Alpha adoptions, six independent defect families or paid customer orders.
